fichas.title: Science teaching area
fichas.summary: Science facilities comprise teaching, teaching/practical, practical, preparation, meeting, photo-work, and photo-laboratory rooms. Biology, physics, and chemistry teaching rooms are sized by places; demonstration rooms and subdivided practical areas have stated approximate areas. Preparation, meeting, and materials rooms may be combined or sized for the science area.
uses: Subject preparation, meetings, and materials storage

fichas.title: Photo laboratory
fichas.summary: A dark room for positive photographic work, including enlargement and wet-working areas, negative film development, and film storage. The reference recommends a north-facing location and constant room temperature where possible.
